decision.basis: All 12 fixed-budget primary runs have completed. All six 2-block runs exceed 90% ID exact accuracy, while all six 1-block runs remain below 90%; all have 100% atomic and train-composite exact accuracy. This meets the preregistered condition for the parameter-matched wider 1-block control. Below threshold denotes this budget, not impossibility.
decision.width_selection: Width 180, the multiple of four with parameter count nearest the 2-block width-128 model, was fixed in the confirmation configuration before primary results. No width or training tuning using confirmation outcomes.
